model_update_anchor_relation.scope: deterministic verifier-side relation between retained model-update bytes, signed digests, quantized anchor, and fixed anchor contract

aggregation_replay.interpretation: The harness passes because it detects the Flower multi-tree contract mismatch and validates a corrected deterministic all-tree replay. It does not establish that unmodified Flower 1.23.0 consumed all trees in these multi-iteration deltas.

publication_claim_boundary: Supports model-consistency/accountability validation for the checked relations.
Does not prove XGBoost training correctness.
Does not prove the entire FL computation inside Groth16.
Does not convert the historical Flower 1.23.0 multi-tree behavior into a correct all-tree aggregation result.
